notes.text: The page is Exercice 4.10.7 and explicitly resumes hypotheses and notation of Exercice 4.10.6. It adds condition (Et) for composable u and v. There is no date or own manuscript page number; lower-left 11 is treated as the archive sheet number.
notes.basis: Observation: heading/opening, condition, and lower-left corner; no date inferred.

notes.text: Item 1 asks for the base-change functor by u to define a morphism of sites S(u), equivalently for S(u)* to be left exact. The words du topos are visibly cancelled.
notes.basis: Observation: item 1 wording and overtyped cancellation; not a proof check.

notes.text: Item 2 asks for left exactness of Prol_X, constructs a proposed g as a retraction of f, and writes an adjunction morphism id→f composed with g. The domain after Prol_X has a vee-shaped superscript; nearby superscripts are waves. The first identity subscript is visibly S(X) without a tilde.
notes.basis: Observation: item 2 and crop 04. Mathematics prompted attention to differing superscripts, but did not replace the visible vee or supply a missing tilde.

notes.text: Item 3 asks that the conclusions of items 1 and 2 fail without (Et), suggesting schemes with the f.p.p.f. topology and flat finitely presented morphisms. The source says les conclusion in the singular; fidèlement is cancelled before plats. The S.G.A. 3 IV bracket marks and numeral 3 are handwritten.
notes.basis: Observation: item 3, both halves; no counterexample was proved or checked.
